thread:
Maya: Quick UX check — the new p95 card quick-selects + sampling control prototype is in staging. Keyboard users are getting stuck when tabbing through presets. Anyone seen this?

Sam: Not yet. Can you paste repro steps?

Maya: Open the p95 card, tab into the time presets row, then use right arrow. Focus jumps into the sampling control (low visual contrast) instead of continuing to the close/back controls. Feels non-linear for keyboard nav.

Jon: That matches a DOM ordering issue — sampling sits before the kebab/close in the DOM. Quick fix is to move sampling into the overflow menu so the presets flow straight into action buttons.

Lee: If we hide sampling in the overflow, it's less discoverable. Teams toggle sample rate a lot for noisy workloads. If we move it, can we add a single-key shortcut (e.g., `s`) to open sampling?

Olivia: Also copy: label currently says "Sample rate (auto)" which confuses PMs. Propose "Sampling (data rate)" or "Sampling (reduces noise/cost)". And the aria-label should expose the percent like "Sampling rate, 10%".

Aria: A11y checklist if sampling moves to overflow:
- Ensure overflow trigger is keyboard focusable with `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`.
- Trap focus inside the overflow dialog and restore focus on close.
- Add `aria-live=\"polite\"` on the p95 heading when presets change so screen readers announce the update.
- For presets, use `role=\"listbox\"` + `aria-activedescendant` for arrow navigation rather than tabindex chaining.

Maya: OK design constraints: keep primary presets visible and make sampling reachable within 1-2 keystrokes. Options: 1) Move sampling to overflow + `s` shortcut; 2) Keep sampling visually inline but change DOM order + add a "Skip to chart" keyboard link; 3) Keep as-is but increase contrast and add `aria-describedby` explaining keyboard flow. Thoughts?

Sam: Option 1 is clean long-term. Option 2 works but adding a skip-link inside each card feels heavy.

Jon: I built a preview with Option 1 (sampling moved into kebab, `s` shortcut opens sampling dialog). Preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/proto/p95-card/keyflow (build 42).

Olivia: Quick microcopy: change tooltip to "Control sampling to reduce cost and noise" and make the menu item read "Sampling rate…" with ellipsis to indicate a dialog.

Aria: Sampling dialog must use `role=\"dialog\"`, focus the first control on open, and restore focus to the trigger on close. Also ensure the shortcut announces via `aria-live` when it opens.

design-bot: Preview updated (build 42 -> 43) — includes `aria-live` and sampling moved. Running smoke: keyboard-nav, screen-reader.

Maya: Action list:
- Jon: update PR with `role=listbox` + `aria-activedescendant` for presets and move sampling to overflow.
- Olivia: finalize tooltip + menu copy.
- Aria: a11y checklist sign-off once PR is up.
- Sam: add E2E `s` shortcut test in e2e/ux/keyboard.spec.ts and fire analytics event for sampling toggles (event: `ui.sampling.toggled`, prop: source: "card-overflow"|"card-inline").

Sam: Adding tests + analytics event. Will include unit tests for payload.

Jon: PR is up: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/789 — includes notes and accessibility snippets.

Olivia: Copied updated text into the PR comment.

Aria: I'll review a11y tomorrow morning and run the screen-reader checklist.

Maya: Thanks everyone — will merge after a11y sign-off and green tests. :thumbsup: Any last asks?

Lee: Just one metric ask — log where sampling was toggled from (inline vs overflow) so we can measure discoverability.

Maya: Good call — Sam, please include the `source` prop on the event.

Sam: Done. Tests passing locally, pushing update to the PR.

Maya: Closing loop. :party:
